title: Map retirement observer handshake transport loss without losing in-session recovery
outcome: A genuine transport loss during an observer handshake follows existing endpoint-unavailable/lease-verification recovery instead of escaping as generic terminal daemon_proxy_failed.
acceptance: A no-descriptor retirement regression acknowledges before closing discovery and deterministically exercises observer mid-handshake transport loss.
Explicit endpoint/response authority refusals and caller cancellation keep their existing classifications; no unverified successor launch or request replay is introduced.
Genuine observer handshake IOException/EndOfStreamException does not escape as generic terminal daemon_proxy_failed; the real writer-lease verification remains authoritative.
